title: Force refresh pacman package lists
summary: Force pacman to refresh all package lists, useful when switching mirrors or fixing sync issues.

steps.explain: Refresh all package lists and upgrade the system. The double -y flag forces a refresh even if lists appear up to date.

rollback.explain: Use -Syyuu to downgrade packages that are newer than the mirror's version, preventing partial upgrades.

warnings: Using -Syy is generally unnecessary and wastes bandwidth. Use it only when switching mirrors or fixing sync errors.
If you force refresh, consider using -Syyuu to avoid partial upgrades if the new mirror is out of sync.
